Name: Ilucie's Winter Crops
Author: IlucieYt
Description:
Tired of long winters without much to do? Time to visit Sandy!

Sandy now sells Radicchio, Turnip and Juniper Berry Seeds - they can only be planted and harvested in the winter.

Radicchio can be used to cook a Radicchio salad.
Juniper Berries can be processed into Juniper Gin.

The sell price of the crops and the artisan/cooking products are balanced out, so that it won't feel like cheating to have winter crops.

Have fun :)!
